title: Serie Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the Serie application's configuration file.

order.description: The commit ordering algorithm. The value specified in the command line argument takes precedence.

graph_width.description: The number of terminal columns each graph column occupies. The value specified in the command line argument takes precedence.

compact.description: Whether the subject text hugs each row's own graph edge instead of reserving a fixed width. The value specified in the command line argument takes precedence.

graph_style.description: The commit graph edge style. The value specified in the command line argument takes precedence.

initial_selection.description: The initial selection of commit when starting the application. The value specified in the command line argument takes precedence.

max_count.description: The maximum number of commits to render. Unset renders all commits. The value specified in the command line argument takes precedence.

mode.description: Self-update check mode. "off": never check automatically (manual U key / -U flag still work). "check": check and prompt y/n before updating. "auto": check and install automatically without prompting. The value specified in the command line argument takes precedence.

interval_hours.description: How often (in hours) to check for updates, both at startup and while the app keeps running. The value specified in the command line argument takes precedence.

auto_restart.description: Whether to restart (TUI) or launch (CLI -U) the new version automatically after a successful update, without asking. The value specified in the command line argument takes precedence.

ignore_case.description: Whether to enable ignore case by default.

fuzzy.description: Whether to enable fuzzy matching by default.

tab_width.description: The number of spaces to replace tabs in the user command output.

^commands_[0-9]+$.description: A custom command. The key must be in the format 'commands_{n}' where n is a number.

name.description: The name of the command to be displayed.

commands.description: The command and its arguments to execute.

refresh.description: Whether to reload the repository and refresh the display after executing the command. Available for 'silent' and 'suspend' commands.

external.description: Configuration for external commands used by the application.

clipboard.description:
The clipboard command to use for copy operations.
- "Auto": Use the default clipboard library; falls back to OSC 52 escape sequence when SSH is detected ($SSH_CONNECTION or $SSH_TTY).
- "Osc52": Always use OSC 52 escape sequence (writes to terminal stdout; terminal forwards to local clipboard, supports tmux passthrough).
- { Custom = { commands = ["..."] } }: Use a custom command that receives text via stdin

commands.description: A custom command that receives text via stdin.

cursor_type.description: The type of cursor to display in input fields.

Virtual.description: A string to be used as a virtual cursor.

list.description: Settings for the commit list view.

columns.description: The order and visibility of columns in the commit list.

subject_min_width.description: The minimum width of a subject in the commit list.

date_format.description: The date format for the author date in strftime format.

date_width.description: The width of the author date column.

date_local.description: Whether to show the author date in local timezone.

name_width.description: The width of the author name column.

detail.description: Settings for the commit detail view.

height.description: The height of the commit detail area.

date_format.description: The date format for author/committer dates in strftime format.

date_local.description: Whether to show dates in local timezone.

diff.description: Settings for the single-file diff pane in the commit detail view.

height.description: The height of the file diff area.

user_command.description: Settings for the user command view.

height.description: The height of the user command area.

refs.description: Settings for the refs list view.

width.description: The width of the refs list area.

branches.description: Colors used for the branches in the graph. Should be in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA format.

color.description: The colors of each element of the application. Colors can be specified as ANSI color names (e.g., 'red', 'bright-blue'), 8-bit color indices (e.g., '34', '128'), or 24-bit hex codes (e.g., '#abcdef').

list_selected_fg.description: Foreground color for a selected item in lists.

list_selected_bg.description: Background color for a selected item in lists.

list_ref_paren_fg.description: Color for parentheses surrounding refs in the commit list.

list_ref_branch_fg.description: Color for local branches in the commit list.

list_ref_remote_branch_fg.description: Color for remote branches in the commit list.

list_ref_tag_fg.description: Color for tags in the commit list.

list_ref_stash_fg.description: Color for stashes in the commit list.

list_head_fg.description: Color for the HEAD indicator in the commit list.

list_subject_fg.description: Color for the commit subject in the commit list.

list_name_fg.description: Color for the author name in the commit list.

list_hash_fg.description: Color for the commit hash in the commit list.

list_date_fg.description: Color for the date in the commit list.

list_match_fg.description: Foreground color for a search match in the commit list.

list_match_bg.description: Background color for a search match in the commit list.

detail_label_fg.description: Color for labels in the commit detail view.

detail_name_fg.description: Color for author/committer names in the commit detail view.

detail_date_fg.description: Color for author/committer dates in the commit detail view.

detail_email_fg.description: Color for author/committer email addresses in the commit detail view.

detail_hash_fg.description: Color for the commit hash in the commit detail view.

detail_ref_branch_fg.description: Color for local branches in the commit detail view.

detail_ref_remote_branch_fg.description: Color for remote branches in the commit detail view.

detail_ref_tag_fg.description: Color for tags in the commit detail view.

detail_file_change_add_fg.description: Color for added file status in the commit detail view.

detail_file_change_modify_fg.description: Color for modified file status in the commit detail view.

detail_file_change_delete_fg.description: Color for deleted file status in the commit detail view.

detail_file_change_move_fg.description: Color for moved file status in the commit detail view.

diff_title_path_fg.description: Color for the file path in the diff pane title.

diff_title_hunk_fg.description: Color for the hunk position (n/m) in the diff pane title.

ref_selected_fg.description: Foreground color for a selected item in the refs list.

ref_selected_bg.description: Background color for a selected item in the refs list.

help_block_title_fg.description: Color for block titles in the help view.

help_key_fg.description: Color for key bindings in the help view.

virtual_cursor_fg.description: Foreground color for the virtual cursor.

status_input_fg.description: Foreground color for the status bar in input mode.

status_input_transient_fg.description: Foreground color for transient messages in the status bar.

status_info_fg.description: Color for informational messages in the status bar.

status_success_fg.description: Color for success messages in the status bar.

status_warn_fg.description: Color for warning messages in the status bar.

status_error_fg.description: Color for error messages in the status bar.

keybind.description: Keybinding settings. Each property is an action, and its value is an array of key sequences.

^user_command_[0-9]+$.description: Keybinding to toggle a specific user command view, where the number corresponds to the command in 'core.user_command'.

keybindArray.description: An array of key sequences for an action. Examples: ["q"], ["ctrl-c"], ["j", "down"]
